solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Question put by examiners? Fancy that!

definitions.meaning: examiners quiz candidates on their learning, so this is the question they in effect put
an exclamation of surprise at some news

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses fit the phrase: a literal enquiry into someone's learning, and an idiomatic cry of surprise.

clue.text: Pelt American all round ring? That's horrid

indicators.note: the first pieces sit all round the next one, enclosing it

parts.note: a pelt is an animal's hide
a ring is round, shaped like the letter O

explanation.surface: Someone sees an animal skin wrapped around an American ring and finds it dreadful.
explanation.definitionFit: Something horrid is ugly or repulsive, which is what hideous means.

clue.text: Get the pitch in good order

definitions.text: Get the pitch in good order

parts.words: Get the pitch in good order
parts.note: reads like preparing a sports field, but means adjusting an instrument so its notes are correctly pitched

explanation.definitionFit: To adjust an instrument so it sounds at the right pitch is a verb meaning exactly this.

clue.text: Away from work, one tours a fantastic vale

indicators.note: one word travels round another, holding it inside

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: fantastic means fanciful, so the letters of vale are rearranged

explanation.surface: A holidaymaker off work travels around a fabulous valley.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fantastic' signals the rearranged valley and 'tours' the enclosure; 'Away from work' reads like the start of a holiday picture, and the 'a' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone granted leave of absence is away from their job for a time.

clue.text: Complex King of Thebes

definitions.meaning: a psychoanalytic complex named by Freud after the Greek myth
the mythical king who unknowingly killed his father and wed his mother

explanation.definitionFit: Freud's complex takes its name from the legendary Theban ruler, so both senses point to one name.

clue.text: Number clad in gear that's Scottish

definitions.text: Number clad in gear that's Scottish

parts.words: Number clad in gear that's Scottish
parts.note: a number here is an item of clothing; this one is worn by men dressed in Highland gear

explanation.surface: A performer dressed in Highland costume.
explanation.definitionFit: The pleated tartan skirt is the item of clothing typical of traditional Highland dress.

clue.text: The head gives old boy lines!

parts.note: OB is the abbreviation for old boy, a former pupil
verse is written in lines

explanation.surface: A headmaster hands a former pupil some lines of poetry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The head' is not a headmaster: it is the side of a coin bearing the head.
explanation.definitionFit: On a coin, the side showing the monarch's portrait is called the obverse, the heads side.

clue.text: Declare all points in order

parts.note: sounds like setting out arguments, but means reciting the thirty-two compass points in sequence

explanation.definitionFit: Naming every compass point in turn is the sailor's idiom described, extended to mean a full reversal.

clue.text: Race can be a big subject

definitions.meaning: the famous steeplechase run at Aintree, near Liverpool
read literally, a grand (big) national (subject of a state)

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase names the Aintree horse race and, taken word by word, an important citizen.

clue.text: Maybe first or second row in exam

indicators.note: one word sits inside the other

parts.note: an oral is a spoken exam
a row is a din, a loud noise

explanation.surface: Coming first or second in a row during an examination.
explanation.definitionFit: First and second are examples of numbers showing position in a series.

clue.text: Free to speak

definitions.meaning: to set free, release or rescue
to utter, as when giving a speech

explanation.definitionFit: The verb means both to rescue someone and to give a speech or verdict.

clue.text: Left-winger has pace

definitions.meaning: informal short form for a Trotskyist
a horse's gait between walk and canter

explanation.definitionFit: The word is slang for a Trotskyist and also a moderate running gait.

clue.text: They are inclined to prevent steps being taken

definitions.text: They are inclined to prevent steps being taken

parts.words: They are inclined to prevent steps being taken
parts.note: inclined here means sloping; these slopes replace stairs so no steps are needed

explanation.definitionFit: Sloping surfaces built instead of stairs, letting wheels pass without steps.

clue.text: We get involved with the Royal Navy, so did she

indicators.note: the letters become entangled, rearranged together

parts.note: RN is the abbreviation for Royal Navy

explanation.surface: We joined the Navy, and so did she.
explanation.walkthrough: A Wren was a member of the Women's Royal Naval Service, so she too joined the navy.
explanation.definitionFit: A member of the women's naval service was called by this name, so she is one.

clue.text: Convenient Haydn composition

indicators.note: composition means arranging, so the composer's name is rearranged

explanation.surface: A handy piece of music by the composer Haydn.
explanation.walkthrough: 'composition' looks musical, fitting Haydn, but signals the rearrangement.
explanation.definitionFit: Something handy is useful and close by, that is, convenient.

clue.text: Sadly drop out of university, though outstanding

indicators.note: sadly suggests things going wrong, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: Regrettably leaving university early, though a star student.
explanation.walkthrough: 'outstanding' means standing out, projecting, not excellent.
explanation.definitionFit: Proud can mean projecting above a surface, literally standing out.

clue.text: Trap seen, ran out!

indicators.note: out signals the letters are put out of order

explanation.surface: Someone spotted, they ran away from the trap.
explanation.definitionFit: To ensnare is to catch in a snare, a synonym for trap as a verb.

clue.text: Desire in one's child to become a doctor

indicators.note: one word goes inside the other

parts.note: a son is one's child
an urge is a desire

explanation.surface: A parent's wish that their boy becomes a physician.
explanation.definitionFit: A surgeon is a kind of doctor who operates.

clue.text: Completed fitting, and not before time

parts.note: something over is completed or finished
due means fitting or appropriate

explanation.surface: A suit fitting finally done, and about time.
explanation.definitionFit: Something overdue is late, so its arrival is not before time.

clue.text: Cuts in the middle of Greece produce blackout

indicators.note: one piece goes inside the other
the central letters of the word are taken

parts.note: clips are cuts, as in trimming

explanation.surface: Spending cuts in central Greece lead to power failures.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the middle of' takes the two central letters of a six-letter country name, and 'in' places the cuts between them; 'blackout' here is the sun or moon hidden.
explanation.definitionFit: An eclipse blots out the sun or moon, a celestial blackout.

clue.text: He turns out to be an Oriental conqueror

parts.note: E stands for eastern, Oriental
a victor is a conqueror

explanation.surface: He proves to be an Eastern conqueror.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turns out' looks like 'proves', but means throws out, as a landlord does.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who expels tenants from a property is one who throws them out.

clue.text: Suitable wear for a teetotaller?

parts.note: a teetotaller is TT, a ..., and the close-fitting old jacket's name reads that way

explanation.definitionFit: A close-fitting jacket worn by men in past centuries, read as 'double T'.

clue.text: Dingy church has a place in modern history

parts.note: dun is a dull greyish-brown colour
kirk is the Scottish word for church

explanation.surface: A drab church plays a part in recent history.
explanation.walkthrough: The French port was the scene of the 1940 evacuation of British troops.
explanation.definitionFit: The French town is famous for the 1940 evacuation, an event of modern history.

clue.text: Badly leaking connection

indicators.note: badly signals the letters come out wrongly arranged

explanation.definitionFit: A linkage is a connection or system of links.

clue.text: Heap of carpets

definitions.meaning: the raised surface of fibres on a carpet

explanation.definitionFit: The word means a heap and the soft raised surface of a carpet.

clue.text: It has many keys but normally only one lock

definitions.text: It has many keys but normally only one lock

parts.words: It has many keys but normally only one lock
parts.note: keys here are the instrument's black and white keys, while it has one lock for its lid

explanation.definitionFit: The keyboard instrument has many keys and one lock on its lid.

clue.text: Free, some bound off

indicators.note: some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.definitionFit: To undo is to unfasten or loosen, setting something free.

clue.text: Gun may be mounted

definitions.meaning: a young horse can be ridden

explanation.definitionFit: The word is a revolver brand and a young male horse that can be ridden.

clue.text: I'd look up to see a star

indicators.note: in a down clue the word is read upwards, backwards

parts.note: lo means look

explanation.surface: I'd look up to see a star in the sky.
explanation.definitionFit: An idol is a celebrity, a star admired by fans.

clue.text: Drink alcohol as a prop

parts.note: to sup is to drink
port is a fortified wine

explanation.definitionFit: A support is a prop holding something up.

clue.text: Asian country incorporating an American state

indicators.note: one word takes the other into its body

parts.note: India is a country in Asia
taken as written

explanation.surface: An Asian country including a US state.
explanation.definitionFit: Indiana is one of the fifty United States.

clue.text: A fair example of downward spiral motion

definitions.text: A fair example of downward spiral motion

parts.words: A fair example of downward spiral motion
parts.note: fair means a funfair: its slide spirals down a tower, and the phrase means chaotic haste

explanation.definitionFit: A spiral slide at a fairground, whose name also means disorderly haste.
